notes.title: STEEL CARNELIAN
notes.notes:
We mentioned this in our Splatter anniversary announcement nine months ago, but over at Catbird Soft we're working on a new game.  We showed you a quick gif then, but now we've got a whole trailer and a Steam page for you to salivate over!

[previewyoutube=aNEMIHhY2rs;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]

Steel Carnelian is a high-octane shoot-em-up set in the near future. Cassandra “Cass” Harrison is a mech-suited mercenary for hire. Join her and her loyal crew as they embark on the most dangerous mission of their lives - rescuing a VIP held hostage inside an automated weapons factory.

Just like Splatter, where we dropped a demo well before the full game's release, we're going to make sure you have a chance to try Steel Carnelian for yourself before you even think about giving us money.  The game's "pilot episode" releases in early 2025. It's gonna contain several stages, three bosses and its own small story.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3060340/Steel_Carnelian/]Here's a link to the Steel Carnelian Steam page.[/url]  You should wishlist it. Just ironically, as a joke, haha. You know because it would be so funny if a bunch of people wishlisted it and then it got popular.  C'mon. You love irony. Wishlist the game.

notes.title: One Year Of Splatter
notes.notes:
It's been a year and a week since we launched Splatter.  

First, patch notes: To celebrate our release anniversary, we've added developer commentary to some of the game's levels.  Check the "commentary" box on the level select screen and you'll hear us talk about things like releasing demos, pitching to publishers, and the secret reason why the weapon charge meters are labeled "testosterone" and "estrogen."

This will probably be our last content update for Splatter.  We might have a few devs add more commentary (it's been a pretty busy few weeks, and we weren't able to get everything we wanted recorded in time for the anniversary), but otherwise, the game feels complete and it's time we put the damn thing to bed.  Thanks for coming with us on this journey.

[h2]Looking Back At 2023[/h2]

Splatter was, as you all know, an unexpected smash hit, selling dozens of copies and inspiring countless imitators.  The cultural phenomenon that is "Splatter" has shown up in a variety of unexpected places this year, and we figured we'd highlight a few of them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41339730/29f1737ffed9f375453519e96a486f4ff96a37aa.png[/img]
Former president Barack Obama showing off his Splatter enthusiasm with a sick "Knot Topic" tee shirt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41339730/e5bb9b83e615d99127fa0603768ece1eb6eaa83d.png[/img]
Genius financier Sam "Bank Man" Fried endorses the use of Coin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41339730/40579778a66f5ce2cb7533e70e39a5881afd7154.png[/img]
Singer-songwriter Taylor Swift seen holding hands with Splatter Guy in public.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41339730/4615fa25d2b7e53fe9426a2aec93d57fd30c3ec5.png[/img]
Taylor Swift announces breakup with Splatter Guy after audio surfaces of offensive comments made on the "Adam Friedland Show" podcast, as well as the "Mueller She Wrote" podcast and "The Magnus Archives" podcast.

[h2]Looking Forward At 2023 Part 2[/h2]

The team that released Splatter a year ago is now two teams working on separate projects.  I'd like to close this out by encouraging you to check out the stuff that both the Catbird team and the Rat King team are doing, because we've both got some pretty neat stuff in the oven.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41339730/d93782500cca814765120773c1f9c7fb11b7c720.png[/img]

The Rat King team has developed [url=https://ratkingcollective.itch.io/littlestpetshooter]Littlest Pet Shooter,[/url] a hybrid FPS / pet sim built for the 7DFPS game jam.  You can keep tabs on their work via their [url=https://twitter.com/rattusrattusart]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/dBB6qyKW2t]Discord[/url].

Over at Catbird, we're working on a game called Steel Carnelian:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41339730/d86067d8cadbb58a3c1c3df83621d1bdb13fb7c8.gif[/img]

It's a shooter / platformer with robots and tons of bullets, but that uppercut was the coolest clip I could fit into a 5mb gif so it's what I went with.  If you want to see more, check out our [url=https://twitter.com/catbirdsoft]Twitter[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/catbirdsoft.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url], or [url=https://discord.gg/qHwEzrygmd]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Trading Cards
notes.notes:

Go now. Collect cards and experience the emotional fulfillment that only a pile of jpeg files can bring.

notes.title: The Hardcore Update
notes.notes:
Added a new HARDCORE hack which is available once you have mastered a level.
-Score gain is increased by 10%.
-Enemies learn faster.
-Healing is significantly slower.
-If you are hit while healing, you will stop healing.
-Automatic ammo regen is disabled.
-To regenerate ammo with a weapon, hit an enemy with your other weapon.
-Hitting enemies with a melee attack regenerates 25% ammo.
-Trying to shoot without sufficient ammo damages you.
-Some enemies will have censorship applied to the explicit parts of their body. This does nothing except protect their privacy.

Additional Patch Notes:
-Added a 3D Graphics option in the options menu. This enables Anaglyphic 3D. I don't know how well the 3D effect works because I don't have any glasses for it, but it looks pretty sick.
-Removed Session 17, since nobody found it and clearly that means y'all don't want it enough.
-Added a failsafe to the boss to reset them if they throw a fit and stop moving.
-Fixed some frame stutters in the ending cinematic.
-Fixed hitmarker effects not applying for a variety of weapons.

notes.title: New Project, New Patreon
notes.notes:
[b]Rat King Never Sleeps.[/b]  Since the release of Splatter, we have been [u]toiling tirelessly[/u] on our next Major Project, and now we are ready to [i]Reveal It To You[/i]... for the low low price of like $5 a month or something.

Long story short, we got a Patreon, and next week (April 2nd) we'll be doing a little announcement post about our next game there, exclusively for our subscribers.  [url=https://www.patreon.com/RatKingCollective]You can join the Patreon here[/url].

If you don't feel like joining the Patreon, just stick around. We'll tell you about the new game eventually, when we get bored enough and want to see your reactions.

notes.title: Splatter: The "Content" Update
notes.notes:
THE CONTENT:
-Added new features, mapped by default to the 1 and 2 buttons on the num row.  I'm not telling you what these do. You have to find out for yourself. Feature 2 is disabled in the tutorial.

THE FIXES:
-Somebody reported that enemies sticking to you bug after I swear I got it dealt with, so enemy melee tracking is now a feature you can disable.  If the enemies stick to you, disable their melee tracking in the options menu and they will stop. You can also do this if you just want an easier experience, it won't ruin the game or anything.
-Fixed some splatmapping issues.
-Fixed an issue with Session 10's coins causing the level to become impossible.
-Removed one of the two guys from that section in Session 8.
-Fixed an issue that let Goop damage stack to ridiculous levels.  Y'all were Gooping too hard and it had to stop.

notes.title: can't believe i forgot to set this live when i finished it
notes.notes: this patch fixes a bug on certain machines that caused enemies to stick to the player.  won't affect most players but if you were the 1 in 300 or so who bought the game and gave up b/c of the bug, please. give it another go

notes.title: small update
notes.notes:
-Fixed a bug where beam weapons (GAZE and VOLT) didn't properly deactivate their projectile when another weapon was equipped.
-Adjusted the death zone in Session 6 so that it actually kills you.
-Adjusted the final area in Session 8 so players can't fall in the central hole. I would have made it do damage, but Session 8 has caused a lot of player frustration and so I felt like a friendlier solution was ideal.
-Fixed several bugs that were causing the boss to freeze permanently.

notes.title: hotfix
notes.notes: fixed a hard lock in the tutorial.

notes.title: some bug fixes
notes.notes:
-fixed two bugs that could cause issues with weapon switching. for the curious, one bug involved an animation transition taking too long and causing the player's ability to switch weapons to reset, and another one involved the player being able to switch weapons while drinking a healing can.
-removed a cheese option on level 11. we knew about this one prior to release but i thought it would be funny to leave it in until somebody found it. it took y'all nearly 2 weeks!
-hopefully fixed an issue on certain machines that could cause enemies to get "stuck" to the player's position. Please lmk if this one is still busted! If it is, you can access a version of the game with the issue-causing feature disabled by using the beta password 'trailercapturing.'

notes.title: Small Content + Fixes Update
notes.notes:
-added three new cosmetics!
	-Unnamed, a new ring, is unlocked by purchasing the horror-RPG An Outcry on Steam.
	-Terroir, a new color set, is unlocked by purchasing the run-and-gun adventure Escape From Terror City on Steam.
	-Freedom's Caress, a new nail style, is unlocked by mastering Session 5.

-attempted to fix some enemy collision bugs
	-enemies will hang back more and thus will be less likely to push you through certain walls
	-if an enemy ends up inside your player collider, it should die instantly now.

-improved health pickup visibility
	-cans now have a distinctive outline around them
	-candy bars are now larger 

-fixed collision on the roulette barrier in Session 10
-optimized decal geometry in Session 9
-doubled weapon spawn rate in Session 16
-fixed an issue where enemies would fall out of bounds and give players impossible amounts of points
-improved the objective display in Session 6
-vastly reduced fall damage when enemy damage is set to minimum in the "Hacks" panel.
-removed excess console logging in Session 5 (this could degrade performance)
-improved enemy visibility on the minimap with new, higher contrast markers
-audio settings should now correctly apply on level startup

notes.title: Day 3 patch
notes.notes:
-Rail now penetrates enemies.  If you can show us a clip of a multikill headshot, we'll shout you out on social media.
-Fixed a navmesh issue on Session 4
-Platforms on the Session 10 jump pad sequences are a lot more forgiving now (1.5x as big).

Things we're working on:
-More weapon spawns in Session 16
-Some radar improvements to make it easier to parse
-Some options menu improvements (and potentially some additional performance options)
-Some additional cosmetics!

Let us know if this update breaks anything, or if there's anything else you want out of the game. Thanks!

notes.title: day 2 patch
notes.notes:
-water in session 15 now correctly splish-splashes
-fixed a bug that caused enemies to sometimes respawn with active lasers or flamethrowers
-made some code changes to reduce bugs while weapon switching. let me know if this has an impact!
-made some code changes to prevent bugs while spawning into the "lava" room of session 16.
-updated the navmesh in the "statue" room of session 16.
-fixed a sequence break that locked players out of progressing in session 8
-enabled the "acquire all cosmetics" achievement.
-updated the way we send leaderboard scores to Steam. let me know if you experience any bugs with this!

notes.title: just a little patch

-hacks correctly reduce score in all levels
-reduced difficulty in level 7's final objective
-fixed an issue where goop could lock up if you fired right after switching from it
-reduced shadowcasters in level 12 to improve performance there hopefully
